literal_meaning: গোলগাল ও মোটা হওয়ার অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic imitation of plumpness and roundness)
figurative_meaning_en: plump and round, fat and flabby, healthy and well-nourished
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই নাদুসনুদুস ছেলেটি দেখতে খুব আকর্ষণীয়।
example_sentences_in_english: That plump boy looks very attractive.
The chubby girls in the village make everyone smile.
note: This idiom is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in colloquial Bengali to affectionately describe healthy, rounded body types, especially in children.
